[[File:Crowd_control_stormtrooper.jpg|250px|thumb|Crowd Control Stormtrooper with thruster pack]]
A '''crowd control thruster pack''' was an armed repulsor [[Jetpack/Legends|jetback]] used by [[Crowd Control Stormtrooper]]s. The pack was equipped with bolstered arms on which were mounted a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster]] module, a [[capture claw]], and a [[supercharged taser]]. Its two large thrusters enabled the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to fly at speeds up to 200 km per hour. However, the vehicles were also relatively quiet, which led to their occasional use by the [[Imperial Espionage Division]]. These stormtroopers came from [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="POTF">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Crowd Control Stormtrooper|link=POTF2dlxstorm.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Crowd Control Stormtrooper was created by [[Hasbro]] in [[1996]], as an action figure in the second [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Power of the Force'']] toy line.<ref name="TAFA">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>
